text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area were estimated to be at the following levels currently, a week ago and a year ago, industry sources said. All figures in thousands of tonnes:
Gasoline stocks rose slightly over the past week with incoming barges offsetting material heading into Germany and NWE.
Naphtha stocks were a touch higher.

Gas oil was active with material heading out into Germany and Switzerland, particuarly diesel grade. Benelux also drew out product, but incoming material from CIS and the Mediterranean offset this draw.
Fuel was broadly balanced with product heading into the bunker market and VGO going into Germany. Jet was unchanged with outgoing directed towards the aviation sector.
